title: H-CLOCK60-1: the native hourly business walk survives a registration whose business type does not resolve. Host only (the rig needs two instances; the client just joins and watches). One of the host's own rented shops is given the unresolvable type 'bogusmod:businesstype_missing' IN MEMORY by the DEV lever `settype`; the clock is moved to three minutes before an hour and LIVE time crosses it, so the NATIVE hour loop really runs. The hour must roll, the two [Clock] lines must appear, no tick must be swallowed; then the old type is put back and one more hour is crossed clean. NO save.
preconditions: Fixture save1 (host melaus, Client1). Dev build with the levers settype / clock (BAMP_DEV). The host must rent at least one registration with a non-empty business type - the `settype` discovery step fails loudly if none does. Nothing is ever saved: the planted type lives only in memory and is restored before the end mark.
oracles_report: has NO BUILDING in this world

steps.note: the host's world settles before the clock is touched
PRECONDITION + runtime pick: the host's first rented registration with a real type is the test shop; its type is captured for the restore

Belt for the fixture: blocks the mod's COORDINATED saves on the host while the bogus type is planted (in an MP session the periodic autosave is one of them - the native autosave timer is suppressed/redirected by the mod, MPPatches ~:8351/:8402). It does NOT touch the native timer itself. fixture_reset never restores a .hsg, so nothing may save in this window; 180 s covers the ~60 s the type stays planted.
IN MEMORY ONLY - the type the walk will fail to resolve

expect_log.regex: \[Clock\] hourly walk: '${addr}' has unknown business type

steps.note: BOTH native walks are covered since the manager's fold (RunHourly and UpdateAllSecurityLevels): no TICK-ISO swallow and no tick-wall line may appear - they are hard absent oracles again. PRECONDITION of the absent oracles: the stand-in was ACCEPTED on this game build ('stand-in verified'). If a game update gives 'ba:businesstype_empty' a simulator or the allowtheft tag the mod REFUSES the stand-in by design and the tick wall carries the throw - this step then fails first, with that reason, instead of the guard oracles misreporting a correct build.
live time crosses the boundary through the ordinary tick
THE CLOCK ASSERTION: the hour really rolled (a different hour) and it reads 0-23 with a fraction, i.e. Minute < 60 - a stalled walk leaves Minute piling up past 60
the shop is handed back its real type; nothing was ever written to a save
one more live boundary, this time with the real type
the clean hour: it rolls again. No new hazard/walk line for this address may appear after the RESTORED mark - read the host log from that mark
